{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABf9LH7A", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhJaC-U", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 106, "title": "Make Retro CRT the default display effect for new visitors", "body": "## Problem

Issue #97 / PR #98 added optional LCD/CRT shaders, but `web/src/display.ts` still defaults to `lcd-light` when the browser has no saved display preference. The desired presentation is **Retro CRT by default**. The CRT effect is a deliberate aesthetic choice, not a statement that the WonderSwan used a CRT.

## Expected outcome

A new visitor with working WebGL2 starts with the existing **Retro CRT** effect selected and visible. An existing user who explicitly selected Clean, LCD Light, LCD Authentic or Retro CRT keeps that setting across reloads. If WebGL2 or shader initialization fails, the existing 2D Clean fallback remains usable. Game state and rendering accuracy in Clean mode are unaffected.

## Context and reproduction

- Current default is `effect: DisplayEffect = "lcd-light"` in [`web/src/display.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/web/src/display.ts).
- The [`web/index.html` help text](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/web/index.html) and [README](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/README.md) name LCD Light as the new-visitor default.
- [`web/scripts/lcd-output.mjs`](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/web/scripts/lcd-output.mjs) explicitly tests that fresh or invalid/denied preference storage selects LCD Light; adjust the expected default **without weakening other tests**.
- Existing `wonderswan:display:v1` values must keep their meaning. Changing the default must not clear the key, migrate user choices, or write a new preference on startup.
- Follow [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md) and [UI/UX principles](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/main/README.md#uiux).

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replace only the **unsaved/invalid-preference default** with `retro-crt` (using the existing shader). Existing valid saved choices remain unchanged, and switching presets still works immediately even when paused.
- [ ] Keep the fallback to **Clean** for unavailable/lost WebGL2 or failed shaders. Do not replace the 2D canvas fallback or make a shader required for gameplay.
- [ ] Update Settings / Help and README so that **Retro CRT** is documented as the new default, clearly labeled as a stylistic CRT effect rather than actual WonderSwan LCD hardware.
- [ ] Extend existing production-preview Playwright default/fallback assertions to cover a fresh visitor (CRT selected and actually rendered), persisted Clean and LCD preferences, and invalid/denied storage. Keep other LCD grid, history, model and portrait assertions intact.
- [ ] Run applicable frontend build/browser checks using existing scripts, note results and omissions accurately. No Rust core, ROM fixture, unrelated UI redesign or new dependency is needed.

## Optional validation

Check the Retro CRT default appearance on a real mobile browser and portrait cartridge, where already supported, especially in light of [the open Chrome 157 portrait corner investigation #100](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/100). This is not evidence that #100 is caused by the default change.

## Required post-merge verification

After merging a fully validated PR, check that GitHub Pages deployment succeeds and the published site presents CRT for a new visitor while retaining a previously selected mode. Record any production-only defect in a separate linked Issue; do not reopen a completed Issue solely for this step.
